title: Session
description: Server-side login session behind the ops_session cookie (IAM-08). Not master data, but part of the core contract every module reads.

_id.description: SHA-256 of the random cookie value - the cookie value itself is never stored.

sessionVersion.description: Copy of persons.session_version; a mismatch means revoked.

plantId.description: Plant chosen in the header's plant switcher.

expiresAt.description: TTL index removes the session afterwards. Card sessions slide: the portal moves it to the last activity plus the idle time (default 60 minutes), never past the start plus the card lifetime (default 12.5 hours).

authenticationMethod.description: Portal-issued authentication method. Missing means password. entra and card never require the local initial-password change; none grants anything.

deviceId.description: Card sessions: the registered terminal (display_devices id) the card was used on.
